text:
leah (Design): quick sync 161616 - noticed a confusing flow in Roles matrix -> Audit. If you click the chevron on a role row and hit 'View audit' we open the Audit Log, but no role filter is applied. Users lose context and have to re-filter. prototype: https://redwood.app/proto/roles-audit :zap:
sanjay (PM): saw this in support too. Ticket where admin couldn't find the grant event because global log defaulted to 'All actions'. We should preserve context or surface a small toast that says 'Showing events for Role: X'.
noah (FE): implementation notes: current nav is `navigate('/audit')`. We can add query param `?role=role_id` and set the audit log to hydrate filters from URL. Minimal change, low-risk. But need UX for when role mappings change (old role_id gone). Also need to decide whether deep-linking opens expanded row.
rachel (Security): important: when we deep-link into audit with role filter, ensure we don't expose org-internal role ids in the URL for non-admins. Maybe use slug/name rather than internal UUID. Also confirm RBAC: only show events the viewer is permitted to see.
kim (A11y): two a11y nits: 1) the chevron button currently has aria-label="Open" which is ambiguous; suggest aria-label="Open role details for {roleName}". 2) audit filter chips are not keyboard-focusable in the current build (tab skips them). Need tabindex=0 or use buttons.
leah (Design): good call on aria. Also design suggestion: instead of redirecting, consider a small drawer anchored to the role row with inline events preview and a 'Open full audit' link. That keeps context and reduces nav cost. Sketch: https://redwood.app/s/shot-audit-drawer
sanjay (PM): both approaches valid. Prioritize drawer for discoverability in 1.27, but for quick fix add URL filter behavior so support can point to deep links.
noah (FE): plan: 1) quick fix: add `?role={slug}` deep-link and update audit page to apply filters from URL, fallback to 'All actions' if slug missing. 2) follow-up: drawer POC (will need CSS for overlay, and re-use audit list component). Will put PR for quick fix today.
rachel (Security): also check logs leakage in querystrings for external sharing. Querystrings may get logged by proxy; avoid putting PII. Roles are fine but don't include user emails.
kim (A11y): for the drawer POC, ensure it traps focus when modal, or use non-modal region with aria-live for updates. Also keyboard shortcut idea: 'g then a' goes to audit; maybe 'g then r' should open the roles page. Add to keyboard docs if we add drawer behavior.
leah (Design): copy tweak for the 'Open full audit' link: propose "View full audit for \u201c{{roleName}}\u201d" (avoid 'log' word). And small helper under the role row: "Recent changes to this role" (muted). Keep copy short.
sanjay (PM): jotting down acceptance criteria for quick fix: - clicking View audit sets URL filter and highlights filter chip; - audit page applies filter from URL on load; - aria-labels updated; - no exposing sensitive tokens. QA notes: keyboard focus on filter chips, contrast >= 4.5:1. Target: hotfix today, drawer in next sprint.
noah (FE): PR link when opened. I'll include test for nil slug and role-not-found fallback. Quick code snippet for URL handling: ```js
const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const role = params.get('role');
if (role) applyRoleFilter(role);
```

leah (Design): thanks! I'll drop drawer mocks and copy strings to the ticket.
staging-bot: quick preview deployed to staging at 2026-03-24T09:12Z for branch feat/audit-role-filter :white_check_mark:
sanjay (PM): thanks everyone, can we do a 10 min keyboard-only pass after lunch? want to catch tab order issues. :coffee:
leah (Design): yep, i'll join.
